title: The Hen on the Bed
lines: The hen naps on his bed.
Ben gets in bed. It is wet!
The hen sat in the wet fog.
Ben gets a rag and a mop.
The hen naps on the rug.
Ben nods and gets in his bed.

questions.listenFor: The hen sat in the fog and then napped on the bed. If they only say "the hen," ask "and where had the hen been?"

questions.ask: What does Ben get to clean up?
questions.listenFor: A rag and a mop. This is stated right in the story - have them reread that line if they cannot find it.

questions.ask: Do you think the hen should nap on the bed? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story, not just yes or no.
